growth_model.spec: Δlog(pop_T) ~ α + β_lag·log(pop_{T-100}) + Σ β_k·z(factor_k at start)

rf_ceiling.spec: Random Forest, same features as growth_model

cross_sectional_level_model.spec: log(pop_T) ~ α + Σ β_k·z(factor_k at T) + year_FE

interpretation: Growth model temporal holdout R² < 0 means the 1400-1500 period was a regime shift (post-Black-Death recovery) the 1200-1400 training data cannot anticipate; the AR(1) baseline shows the same — even lagged pop fails to extrapolate. The k-fold CV R² is the correct measure of how much within-period variance the factors explain. The cross-sectional level model answers the different question 'how big is this city, given its factors?' — this is what the heuristic composite implicitly fits, and is the appropriate comparison for the report's old composite-vs-1500-pop scatter.
